chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from Abu Ayyub al-Madaini, from Sulayman al-Ja'fari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them), who said:

Do not eat the grouse, nor insult it, nor give it to the children to play with it, for it is frequent in the glorification of Allah (Exalted), and its glorification is: 'May Allah curse those who hate the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon them)'.

key_terms.التَّسْبِيحِ: Glorification (reciting SubhanAllah), here attributed to the bird.
key_terms.الْقُنْبُرَةَ: The grouse, a type of bird mentioned in this narration.
key_terms.مُبْغِضِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: Those who hate the Progeny of Muhammad (peace be upon them).

ai.seo_question: Why should one avoid eating the grouse bird according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) links the physical consumption of the grouse to a metaphysical reality, noting that the bird frequently recites the glorification of Allah. He specifies that its unique form of tasbih serves as a curse upon those who harbor enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt, thereby elevating the bird to a spiritual witness in the cosmic struggle between truth and opposition to the Prophet's household. This ruling illustrates the Shia concept of 'isnad al-kalam' (attribution of speech) to animals, where their natural states reflect theological truths.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Abu Ayoub Al Madainy, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> grandfather<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Do not eat the grouse, nor insult it, nor give it to the children to play with it, for it frequents the Glorification of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and its Glorification is, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse those who hate the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman from abu Ayyub al- Madiniy from Sulayman al-Ja‘fariy who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has narrated from his father

this Hadith. ’Do not use lark for food, do not abuse it and do not give it to children to play with; it says Tasbih a great deal and it is, ‘O Allah, condemn those who hate Muhammad and his family, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
